title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language

claims.claim: Palette, IBM Design Language'i takip eden 20 milyar parametreli bir modeli fine-tune etmiştir.

evidence.quote: We fine-tuned a 20B model to build decks the way people do: a designer plans the deck and a coder draws each slide. Its training data follows the IBM Design Language, and on PresentBench it ranks first on two of the three domains we measured.
We fine-tuned a 20B model to build decks the way people do: a designer plans the deck and a coder draws each slide. Its training data follows the IBM Design Language...

claims.claim: Palette, PresentBench üzerinde ölçülen üç domenden ikisinde birinci sırada yer almaktadır.

evidence.quote: Its training data follows the IBM Design Language, and on PresentBench it ranks first on two of the three domains we measured.
...and on PresentBench it ranks first on two of the three domains we measured.

claims.claim: Eğitim verileri için yaklaşık 10.000 slaytı kapsayan yaklaşık 1000 sunum üretilmiştir.

evidence.quote: We generated around 1000 decks covering roughly 10,000 slides.

claims.claim: Harness, 131 sunum boyunca ortalama 3.5 puan eklemektedir.
Üç domen genelinde Palette, NotebookLM'in 1.1 puan gerisinde 59.7 puanla ikinci sırada yer almaktadır.

evidence.quote: The data recipes include directives from 12 categories, a few of which are shown below, each phrased several different ways, so the model learns the intent rather than a fixed phrase.
The data recipes include directives from 12 categories, a few of which are shown below...

claims.claim: Kodlayıcı örnekleri tasarımcı örneklerinden yaklaşık 5 kat daha uzundur.

evidence.quote: One lesson: coder examples are about 5× longer than designer examples, so a naive mix undertrained the designer until we oversampled its examples 5×.
One lesson: coder examples are about 5× longer than designer examples...
